production-readiness.notes: Runs automated HANA, S4H/ABAP, host, security, and monitoring checks only on servers whose generated component groups make them applicable.

fully-tested.notes: Runs fully tested automated checks only on servers whose generated component groups make them applicable.

prepatch-quick.notes: Runs the fast Claire pre-patch connectivity, OS-health, service, replication, and immediate patch-readiness checks.

prepatch-full.notes: Runs every integrated Claire Prepatch check on applicable HANA DB hosts.
